pumi.workflow.v1.Transition.jsonschema.j.description: Transition is one transition of a state (decision 0168).

action.description:
The name of the Cedar action that guards the transition, as
 pumi.cedarschema declares it, such as "advance" or "retry".

target.description: The name of the state the transition goes to.

pumi.workflow.v1.Transition.jsonschema.j.title: Transition

pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.InvocationCapRe.description:
InvocationCapReached fires on the invocation.finished event of the
 invocation that the state started when its outcome is cap reached,
 instead of InvocationResult (decision 0203). Every state that starts an
 invocation declares it.
pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.InvocationCapRe.title: Invocation Cap Reached

pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.InvocationFaile.description:
InvocationFailed fires on the invocation.finished event of the
 invocation that the state started when its outcome is failed, instead
 of InvocationResult (decision 0235). Every state that starts an
 invocation declares it.
pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.InvocationFaile.title: Invocation Failed

pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.InvocationInDou.description:
InvocationInDoubt fires when the invocation that the state started is
 in doubt: its last lease ended with no result (decisions 0199 and 0200).
 A state that starts an agent run or an external action declares it; a
 check in doubt runs again, so a state that starts one does not.
pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.InvocationInDou.title: Invocation In Doubt

pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.InvocationResul.description:
InvocationResult fires on the invocation.finished event of the
 invocation that the state started when its outcome is succeeded, or
 resolved on recovery for an external action that happened (decisions
 0202 and 0235).
pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.InvocationResul.title: Invocation Result

pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.StateEntered.js.description:
StateEntered fires as the state is entered, for a state that only
 decides.
pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.StateEntered.js.title: State Entered

pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.jsonschema.json.description:
Trigger is what fires a transition (decision 0170): exactly one of these.
 The kernel reads triggers from Subscribe in log order, and each event
 fires at most once.

^(cap_reached)$.description:
The state's invocation reached a cap of its budget: its wall-time
 limit, or its token or cost cap at the model gateway.

^(in_doubt)$.description: The state's invocation is in doubt.

capReached.description:
The state's invocation reached a cap of its budget: its wall-time
 limit, or its token or cost cap at the model gateway.

event.description:
An event whose subject is the plan, by its CloudEvents type, such as
 "dev.getpumi.approval.recorded" (decision 0135).

inDoubt.description: The state's invocation is in doubt.

result.description: The result of the state's invocation.

pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.jsonschema.json.title: Trigger
